# The Magyar horse-archer company: MGY-only swords for hire (tag-gated),
# all-cavalry, full strength on hiring like every mercenary company. Rate
# follows the vanilla scale (0.1 ~= 1 regiment per 10 dev): 0.5 fills about
# eight regiments from MGY's dev, inside the 12-cavalry cap. Bonus and rate
# are first-pass numbers for the balance pass; the 500-ducat on_startup
# chest is sized to actually hire it.
merc_magyar_horse = {
	regiments_per_development = 0.5
	home_province = 283 # Zaporozhia
	cavalry_weight = 1.0
	cavalry_cap = 12
	sprites = { easterngfx_sprite_pack }
	trigger = {
		is_allowed_to_recruit_mercenaries = yes
		tag = MGY
	}
	modifier = {
		cavalry_power = 0.1
	}
}
